subject: real time convergence view in stan

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: real time convergence view in stan
parts:
Hi,

Did anybody try to display trace real time in rstan?  stan function has parameter  sample_file.  I think it is possible to write a function to view graphically the content of this file while simulation is running.  I wonder if one could write a function to display the trace real time (as in WinBUGS).  Is there some documentation on the structure of sampling file?

Thank you,
Linas

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] real time convergence view in stan
parts:
The sample file is just a CSV file. There are comments
dumping out all the args, then a header line with each
variable name. Just look at one --- they're all the same.

The doc (or at least a description) is in the CmdStan manual,
subsection "Sampler Output" in Chapter 2.

It may also be documented somewhere in RStan if RStan produces
file-based output --- I know RStan can read in CmdStan's output.

- Bob
